βάλλετο: βάλλω — throw, cast; mid. throw on oneself, sling; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐβάλλετο): ’he slung on’ · also mid. with a passive sense, ’was thrown on’ (ἐπὶ … βάλλετο κῶας ’a fleece was thrown on’, ἐπί in tmesis)
βουλήν: βουλή — plan, counsel, decision; acc. sg. · also council, assembly: ’council-meeting’ (ἐς βουλήν ’to the council’)
γερόντων: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. pl.
δίῳ: δῖος — bright, noble, divine (epic epithet); masc. dat. sg.
δαΐφρονος: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. gen. sg.
εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took up (for herself)’ · also with ἐκ in tmesis: ’took away from’ (ἐκ … εἵλετο)
εἶδός: εἶδος — form, appearance, beauty; neut. acc. sg.; accented before enclitic τε
εὐρυάγυιαν: εὐρυάγυιος — wide-streeted (of a city); fem. acc. sg. εὐρυάγυιαν, agreeing with πόλιν (εὐρύς + ἄγυια ’street’)
εὕδειν: εὕδω — sleep; pres. inf.: ’to sleep’ (with ὤρνυντο, ’bestirred themselves to sleep’)
εὕδοντ: εὕδω — sleep; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (εὕδοντ’ = εὕδοντα)
εὗδον: εὕδω — sleep; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (Attic ηὗδον, ἐκάθευδον): ’I slept’ · also impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they slept’
ζηνὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus; dat. sg., epic stem Ζην- (Ζηνί = Διί)
θέμις: θέμις — custom, what is right, established usage; fem. nom. sg.
θήσειν: τίθημι — put, place, make; fut. inf. θήσειν: ’to make’ (+ pred. adj.)
θείη: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’might make’ (σκέδασιν θείη ’make a scattering’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with an infinitive: ’may (Zeus) grant (that I come)’
θεῖος: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. nom. sg.
θεῖός: θεῖος — divine, from the gods; adj., masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ · also plain acc. sg., direct object of a verb: κινήσας κάρη ’shaking his head’ · also acc. sg. governed by ἀμφί: ’about the head’ (ἀμφὶ κάρη) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’the head’ (κάρη κονίῃσιν ἐμίχθη)
κέλευε: κελεύω — command, order; pres. imper. 2 sg.
κέλευσε: κελεύω — order, command; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκέλευσε)
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’handsomely, finely’ (καλά … κήδεαι ’you care so finely’) · also adverbial neut. acc. pl.: ’well, finely’ (οὐκέτι καλὰ … ἀναχωρήσειν ’no longer well’) · also neut. nom. pl. (same form), agreeing with a plural subject: καλὰ θύρετρα ’the fine doors’
κείνῳ: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. dat. sg.
κηρύκεσσι: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κήρυξι)
κηρύσσειν: κηρύσσω — proclaim, summon by herald; pres. inf.
κλῦτε: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic: ’hear!’
κομόωντας: κομάω — wear one’s hair long; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic diectasis (= Attic κομῶντας)
λιγυφθόγγοισι: λιγύφθογγος — clear-voiced; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
λιπαροῖσιν: λιπαρός — sleek, glistening, glossy (as skin rubbed with oil); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
μέγεθός: μέγεθος — size, stature; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μέδοντες: μέδων — ruler, lord (part. of μέδω ’rule over’, used as noun); masc. voc. pl., address · also masc. nom. pl., subject: ἡγήτορες ἠδὲ μέδοντες ’leaders and rulers’
μέμηλε: μέλω — be a care to (+ dat.); perf. 3 sg. with pres. force, epic (Attic μεμέληκε): ’is a care’
μήδετο: μήδομαι — devise, plan, contrive; impf. 3 sg.: ’was devising, planned’
μεγαθύμων: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. pl.
μερμήριζε: μερμηρίζω — ponder anxiously, be in doubt; impf. 3 sg.: ’pondered’
μηδέ: μηδέ — and not, nor, do not; neg. conj., used to forbid before an imperative · also continuing a purpose clause with the subjunctive: ’and not’ (μηδέ … πάθῃσι ’and may he not suffer’) · also in a wish with the optative, ’and not, nor’: μηδέ … γένοιτο ’and may there not be’ · also with an infinitive used as an imperative: ’and not (to tell)’ (μηδέ … ἐκφάσθαι)
νήδυμος: νήδυμος — sweet, refreshing (stock epithet of sleep; formation disputed, sometimes linked by folk-etymology to ἡδύς); masc. nom. sg.
νήπιος: νήπιος — infant, still a child, witless; masc. nom. sg.
νύκτα: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration: ’(through) the night’ · also direct object of a verb: ’(held back) night’ (νύκτα … σχέθεν)
οὖλον: οὖλος — whole, entire (Attic ὅλος); masc. acc. sg.
πέμψαι: πέμπω — send, convey; aor. inf. act.: ’to send’ · also inf. used as an imperative: ’send (me)’ (ἕσσας με … πέμψαι)
πειρήσομαι: πειράω — try, make trial (of); fut. 1 sg. mid., epic (= Attic πειράσομαι), or hortatory aor. subj.: ’I shall try’
πολυκλήϊσι: πολυκλήϊς — with many oar-benches or thole-pins (sense disputed); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισι
ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
πριάμου: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg.
προσεβήσετο: προσβαίνω — go up to, step onto; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σετο (cf. Attic προσέβη): ’mounted, stepped onto’
προσεφώνεε: προσφωνέω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg., augmented (προσ- + ἐ-φώνεε): ’was speaking to, addressed’
πυκινὴν: πυκινός — close-packed, stout; adj., fem. acc. sg.
σεῦ: σύ — you; gen. sg., epic σεῦ (= Attic σοῦ)
στοναχάς: στοναχή — groan, sigh; fem. acc. pl.
σῇσιν: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with φρεσί
τρωσί: Τρώς — a Trojan; masc. dat. pl. (Τρῶες, Τρωσί): ’Trojans’
υἷι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἷι (= Attic υἱεῖ)
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι) · also attributive, with a noun: φίλοι υἷες ’dear sons’
φαίνετο: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, seem; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφαίνετο)
φράζονται: φράζομαι — consider, devise, plot; pres. mid. 3 pl.
φρεσίν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φόως: φῶς (φάος) — light; neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φῶς)
φᾶρος: φᾶρος — large cloth, robe, web; neut. acc. sg.
φῆ: φημί — say, declare, assert; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφη): ’said, declared’
ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
ἀμβροσίην: ἀμβροσίη — ambrosia, the fragrant food/substance of the gods; fem. acc. sg.
ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb · also + gen.: ’apart from’ (ἀμφὶς φυλόπιδος ’apart from battle-din’)
ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες)
ἀνῆκεν: ἀνίημι — let go, release; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’let go, released’ · also ’urge on, incite’ (+ acc. and inf.): ἀοιδὸν ἀνῆκεν ἀειδέμεναι ’moved the minstrel to sing’
ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.
ἀτρέος: Ἀτρεύς — Atreus, father of Agamemnon and Menelaus; masc. gen. sg.
ἀτρεκέως: ἀτρεκής — exact, unswerving; adv. ἀτρεκέως: ’exactly, precisely’
ἄγετ: ἄγω — lead; pl. imper. ’come now!’, elided (ἄγετ’ = ἄγετε), addressed to a group
ἄγχιστα: ἄγχι — near; superl. adv. ἄγχιστα: ’nearest, most closely’
ἄλγεά: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄλγη); accent from enclitic τε
ἄλλοθεν: ἄλλοθεν — from elsewhere, from another place; adv. (ἄλλος + -θεν ’from’)
ἄνευθεν: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart, aside, at a distance; adv.
ἅπαντας: ἅπας — all, the whole, every; masc. acc. pl.
ἐδήσατο: δέω — bind; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’bound on (for herself)’ · also of a man: ’bound on (for himself)’ (Μενέλαος … ἐδήσατο καλὰ πέδιλα)
ἐκήρυσσον: κηρύσσω — proclaim, make proclamation; impf. 3 pl.
ἐλεαίρει: ἐλεαίρω — pity, feel compassion for (epic by-form of ἐλεέω); pres. 3 sg.
ἐνύπνιον: ἐνύπνιος — in sleep; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’in sleep, in a dream’
ἐπιτέλλω: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, give charge to; pres. 1 sg.: ’I give charge’
ἐφῆπται: ἐφάπτω — fasten upon; perf. pass. 3 sg., + dat.: ’is fastened upon’
ἐῴκει: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; plpf. with impf. force, 3 sg. · also impersonal: ’it was fitting’ (οἷα ἐῴκει ’such as was fitting’)
ἔγρετο: ἐγείρω — wake, rouse; aor. 3 sg. mid., 2nd aorist, epic (sense of Attic ἠγέρθη): ’awoke’
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔμελλεν: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 sg., augmented (root μελλ-, consonant-initial; unaugmented μέλλε(ν)): ’was going to, was destined’
ἔμελλον: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 pl. · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I was destined, was about to’ + fut. inf.
ἔνισπε: ἐνέπω — tell, relate, declare; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’tell!’
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’ (ἔχε σιγῇ μῦθον ’keep the word in silence’) · also of clothing: ’was wearing’ (κυνέην ἔχε ’wore a cap’)
ἕλοι: αἱρέω — take, seize, take hold of; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would take hold of’ (of longing, + gen.) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a general relative without κε: ’whomever sleep may seize’ (ὅν τινα … ἕλοι)
ἕλοις: αἱρέω — take, seize, catch; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you might take, catch’
ἠγείροντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’gathered themselves’
ἠμαθόεντος: ἠμαθόεις — sandy (epithet of Pylos); masc. gen. sg.
ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn; fem. nom. sg. · also a common noun, ’morning’ (ὄφρα μὲν ἠὼς ἦν ’as long as it was morning’)
ἡγήτορες: ἡγήτωρ — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., address: ’leaders!’
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came upon’
ἷζε: ἵζω — sit, sit down, take one’s seat; aor. 3 sg. (root form), unaugmented: ’sat down’
ὄνειρον: ὄνειρος — dream (Homeric also has the neut. by-form ὄνειρον, τό, beside the masc.); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ᾤχετ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ᾤχετ’ = ᾤχετο): ’went’
